Marissa: Heads up: preflight encoder on pod-3 dropped a frame during rehearsal. Switched to enc-backup3. All-hands in ~12m. Need someone to own recorder handoff + captions check. @Jordan can you confirm keynote slide timing? :eyes:
Alex: On it — I'll grab recorder handoff. Zoe, can you confirm captions are pointed to CC service?
Zoe: Captions green, but transcribe service has 2s lag on long monologues. Can add short buffer to OBS. Patch in 30s:
```bash
obs-cli scene switch "AllHands"
obs-cli transition 200
```
Samir: If we add buffer, latency will increase. Suggest keep live captions, post-sync high-quality transcript for uploads. Also who's moderating Q&A queue?
Marissa: Jordan + Product will take lead on Q&A. Samir, can you and Alex run the recorder swap? Alex please follow runbook snippet:
```text
1) stop recorder pod: kubectl -n media scale deploy/recorder --replicas=0
2) confirm backup: curl http://enc-backup3/status
3) scale back up: kubectl -n media scale deploy/recorder --replicas=1
```
Alex: Copy. Doing step 1 now.
InfraBot: Deploy bot: recorder-deploy v2.3 starting 2712345685
Alex: Recorder stopped. Backup shows OK: enc-backup3 status=ready. Scaling back up.
Zoe: I patched OBS transition to +500ms buffer. Should smooth captions. Will monitor.
Jordan: Thanks. Heads-up for leadership: we'll skip the roadmap deep-dive to keep within 60m. Quick product updates only, then 20m Q&A. Any urgent asks call them now.
Marissa: Noted. I'll update slide deck and the agenda in calendar.
Alex: Recorder scaled up and healthy. Recording live at rtmp://recording.redwood/incoming/ah-2712
Marissa: @channel Starting pre-call in 8m. Please mute when not speaking. Bring questions to #all-hands-questions. :mic_muted:
Samir: Noted. I'll watch latency on captions. If it jumps >3s alert here.
Zoe: Seeing ~1.8s now. CPU spike on transcribe host — moving it to t3a.large.
Alex: All-hands streaming live. OBS -> encoder enc-backup3. Any AV issues DM me.
Jordan: Kicking off in 3m. Lead slides go to spot 2, product updates only. I'll open with 5min status.
Marissa: Thanks fam. I'll post followups in #allhands-followups after meeting. :raised_hands:
